subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw let agents create Slack and Discord channels, and if so what explicit operator gate, credential policy, and approval boundary must control that administrative action?
rationale: The code shape is bounded, but autonomous workspace or server mutation changes the security boundary, adds Slack scopes and likely config surface, and cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Approve opt-in provider actions
options.body: Add provider-owned channel creation disabled by default where needed, requiring explicit operator configuration and least-privilege scopes.

options.title: Land Discord CLI only
options.body: Review the existing Discord CLI candidate separately while deferring Slack and the broader cross-provider authority decision.

options.title: Keep provisioning external
options.body: Do not expose channel creation to agents and continue requiring provider-native administration or direct API tooling.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in provider actions
recommendation.body: Add provider-owned channel creation disabled by default where needed, requiring explicit operator configuration and least-privilege scopes.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-history and discussion signal across the exact CLI, Slack, and Discord surfaces involved.
